methodology.full_path_scan: All3538 current C# paths and1022 PCK scene paths were enumerated. This turn recovered nine in-scope empty bodies; five remaining empty files are generated or excluded paths. Enumeration/recovery is not a claim that every method was reviewed.
methodology.nodes: 714 nonempty namespace-declared node files plus2 empty excluded node paths = 716 indexed node files. In-scope recovered method bodies are available for targeted source review. Recovery alone is not implementation or verification evidence.
methodology.method_review: Concrete source methods and scenes identified in module audit documents were reviewed and implemented; a path scan does not assert every method has been reviewed.
methodology.acceptance: Native suites, actual bilingual scene review, browser behavior and linked ARM/Firebird checks are separate evidence. No restoration percentage is inferred from file, model, contract or passing-test counts.
methodology.privacy: Only identifiers, counts, independent implementation summaries and test references are public.
methodology.ftue_review: All thirteen in-scope Ftue classes and their actual callers were reviewed, including mark-on-open versus mark-on-close, two distinct auto-completion counter lifetimes, release-hidden Reset Tutorials, and independent Ascension SeenPopup semantics. See ftue-ui9-0.17.md.
methodology.front_source_review: UI10 reviewed runtime locale substitution, inherited menu/Continue/profile/compendium/statistics/history scenes, General/Input and Standard/Custom/Daily scenes, conditional rows and interactions. Matching I front15 targets pass in each language. Current date/long-press captures were visually reviewed,188 unaffected H-to-I captures are byte-identical, and14 auxiliary differences are explained by source Settings underlays or cursor position. See ui10-front-source-review-0.17.md and settings-run-setup-ui10-0.17.md. Source scans and pixel-oracle counts are not restoration percentages.
methodology.font_variation_scope: The source Chinese Regular resource declares a0.95 transform and-0.05 baseline offset. A direct Godot4.5.1 experiment found equal advance/ascent/descent to the base font at12 sampled sizes; this neither proves a metric defect from those properties nor establishes identical glyph ink/kerning/raster output. Measured LCD integer-advance differences are recorded separately.
